function applyComparePayload(data) {\n    const layersIn = data.layers || {};\n    const algo = data.algorithm || data.metrics?.algorithm || null;\n    if (!state.compare) {\n      state.compare = {\n => [p[0], p[1]]);\n        if (isSampleTraceId()) copy.forEach((p) => { p[1] += 500; });\n        state.compare.layers[algo] = copy;\n        state.resultVisible[algo] = true;\n      } else if (failed) {\n        delete state.compare.layers[algo];\n        state.resultVisible[algo] = false;\n      }\n      state.compare.metricsByAlgo[algo] = {\n        label: data.metrics?.baseline_label || squishDisplayFromRaw(squishRatio)\n      );\n    }\n\n    setCompareRunBusy(true);\n\n    const errors = [];\n    const skipped = [];\n    const ran = [];\n    const needFrechet = [];\n    let      skipped.push(baselineAlgoLabel(algo));\n          anyReady = true;\n          const fr = state.compare.frechet?.byAlgo?.[algo];\n          if (fr == null || (fr.value == null && !fr.loading)) `${baselineAlgoLabel(algo)}: ${plainUserError(data.baseline_error || data.dots_error)}`\n          );\n        } else {\n          ran.push(algo);\n        }\n        if (applyComparePayload(data)) setBaselineStatus(plainUserError(err.message) || \"Compare run failed\", \"error\");\n    } finally {\n      setCompareRunBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function startBaselineFrechet(algo) {\n    if })\n      .then((j) => {\n        if (!state.compare) return;\n        state.compare.frechet.byAlgo[algo] = { loading: false, value: j.distance };\n        const hit = -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function updatePlayButton() {\n    const playIcon = playBtn.querySelector('.play-icon');\n    const pauseIcon = Try again in a moment.\";\n    try {\n      const text = await resp.text();\n      if (!text) return fallback;\n      try {\n        const data = JSON.parse(text);\n        return plainUserError(data.error || fallback);\n      } catch {\n        return plainUserError(text.length <= 200 ? text : fallback);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      return fallback;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function plainUserError(message) {\n    const raw = String(message || \"\").trim();\n    if (!raw) return \"Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.\";\n    const lower = raw.toLowerCase();\n    if (\n      lower.includes(\"binary not found\")\n      || lower.includes(\"binary execution\")\n      || lower.includes(\"simplify failed\")\n      || lower.includes(\"processing timeout\")\n      || /\\/(build|usr|tmp|var)\\//.test(raw)\n      || /\\.cpp|\\.h\\b|traceback|stderr|stack/.test(lower)\n    ) {\n      return \"Could not finish this step. Try a newer browser.\");\n    }\n\n    const reader = resp.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = \"\";\n    let sawDone = false;\n    let sawHeader = false;\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n\n      let newlineIdx;\n      while ((newlineIdx = buffer.indexOf(\"\\n\")) >= 0) {\n        const line = buffer.slice(0, newlineIdx).trim();\n        buffer = buffer.slice(newlineIdx + 1);\n        if (!line) continue;\n\n        let msg;\n        try {\n          msg = JSON.parse(line);\n        } catch (e) {\n          throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n        }\n\n        // Batch JSON accidentally delivered as one NDJSON line.\n        if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = msg;\n          initTraceUI();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n          throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n        }\n        if (msg.type === \"header\") {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = {\n            eps: msg.eps,\n            delta: msg.delta,\n            grid_val: msg.grid_val,\n            r_val: msg.r_val,\n            expected_frechet: msg.expected_frechet,\n            bbox: msg.bbox,\n            stream: msg.stream,\n            prefixes: [],\n            simplified: null,\n            time_ms: null,\n          };\n          sawHeader = true;\n          state.prefixIdx = 0;\n          state.stepIdx = 0;\n          initTraceUI();\n          fitToData();\n          renderBootstrapStatus(state.trace);\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(total ? `Loading points 0 / ${total}…` : \"Loading points…\");\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"prefix\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          const prefix = msg.data;\n          applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(prefix);\n          state.trace.prefixes.push(prefix);\n          if (state.prefixIdx === 0 && prefix.steps.length > 0) {\n            state.stepIdx = 0;\n          }\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            const loaded = Math.min((prefix.end_idx ?? 0) + 1, total || Infinity);\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(\n              total\n                ? `Loading points ${loaded} / ${total}…`\n                : `Loading points ${loaded}…`\n            );\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"done\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n        applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n        state.trace = msg;\n        initTraceUI();\n        finalizeTraceLoad();\n        return;\n      }\n      if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n        throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!sawDone) {\n      if (!sawHeader) {\n        throw new Error(\"No data received from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      throw new Error(\"Loading stopped before the trajectory finished.\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  function loadTraceText(text, name) {\n    let parsed;\n    try {\n      const sizeKB = (text.length / 1024).toFixed(0);\n      console.log(`[Client] Starting JSON.parse of ${sizeKB}KB string...`);\n      uploadStatus.textContent = \"Reading trajectory…\";\n      uploadStatus.style.color = \"#e8c547\";\n      \n      const parseStart = performance.now();\n      parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n      const parseTime = ((performance.now() - parseStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);\n      console.log(`[Client] JSON.parse completed in ${parseTime}s`);\n    } catch (e) {\n      alert(\"This file could not be read as a trajectory. -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function drawPolyline(pts, close) {\n    if (!pts || pts.length < 2) return;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    const [x0, y0] = point-in-polygon (world coords). Returns true if pt is inside poly.\n  function pointInPolygon(pt, poly) {\n    if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return false;\n    const [x, y] = pt;\n    let inside = false;\n    for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {\n      const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];\n      if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi))\n        inside = !inside;\n    }\n    return inside;\n  }\n\n  function dot(p, radius, fillStyle, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n    if (fillStyle) { ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle; ctx.fill(); }\n    if (strokeStyle) { ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke(); }\n  }\n\n  function cross(p, radius, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y - radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + radius);\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y + radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y - radius);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Axis ticks\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function isMobileUI() {\n    return window.matchMedia(\"(max-width: 720px)\").matches;\n  }\n\n  function drawAxisTicks() {\n    const t = state.trace;\n    if (!t || !t.bbox) return;\n    const showCoordLabels = !isMobileUI();\n\n    const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = t.bbox;\n    const xRange = xmax - xmin;\n    const yRange = ymax - ymin;\n\n    // Determine tick spacing based on data size\n    const getTickSpacing = (range) => {\n      const roughTicks = 8;\n      const roughSpacing = range / roughTicks;\n      const magnitude = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(roughSpacing)));\n      const normalized = roughSpacing / magnitude;\n      let nice;\n      if (normalized < 1.5) nice = 1;\n      else if (normalized < 3) nice = 2;\n      else if (normalized < 7) nice = 5;\n      else nice = 10;\n      return nice * magnitude;\n    };\n\n    const xSpacing = getTickSpacing(xRange);\n    const ySpacing = getTickSpacing(yRange);\n\n    // Position axes at the data bounds instead of world origin (0,0)\n    const xAxisY = ymin;\n    const yAxisX = xmin;\n\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#444\";\n    ctx.fillStyle = \"#999\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.font = \"11px monospace\";\n    ctx.textAlign = \"center\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"top\";\n\n    // X-axis ticks\n    const xStart = Math.ceil(xmin / xSpacing) * xSpacing;\n    for (let x = xStart; x <= xmax; x += xSpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(x, xAxisY);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy - 5);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy + 5);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(x.toFixed(0), sx, sy + 8);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Y-axis ticks\n    ctx.textAlign = \"right\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"middle\";\n    const yStart = Math.ceil(ymin / ySpacing) * ySpacing;\n    for (let y = yStart; y <= ymax; y += ySpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, y);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx - 5, sy);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx + 5, sy);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(y.toFixed(0), sx - 8, sy);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Draw axes at the data bounds\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#666\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    // X-axis at bottom of data\n    const [x0Left, y0] = worldToScreen(xmin, xAxisY);\n    const [x0Right, _] = worldToScreen(xmax, xAxisY);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0Left, y0);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0Right, y0);\n    ctx.stroke();\n    // Y-axis at left of data\n    const [x0, y0Bottom] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymin);\n    const [__, y0Top] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymax);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0, y0Bottom);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0, y0Top);\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    // Draw bounding box (always visible, solid lines)\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#888\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    const [bx1, by1] = worldToScreen(xmin, ymin);\n    const [bx2, by2] = worldToScreen(xmax, ymax);\n    ctx.strokeRect(bx1, by2, bx2 - bx1, by1 - by2);\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Main render\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function render() {\n    resizeCanvas();\n    const rect = canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);\n    renderStatus();\n\n    const t = state.trace;\n    const traceLoading = document.body.classList.contains(\"trace-loading\");\n    if (!t) {\n      if (isMobileUI()) {\n        for (const btn of mobileTransportButtons) {\n          if (btn) btn.disabled = true;\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const traceNotReady = traceLoading && (!t.prefixes || t.prefixes.length === 0);\n\n    const pfx = currentPrefix();\n    const step = currentStep();\n\n    // Draw axis ticks\n    drawAxisTicks();\n\n    // Update navigation input fields\n    segmentInput.value = `${state.prefixIdx + 1} / ${t.prefixes.length}`;\n    const n = pfx ? pfx.steps.length : 0;\n    stepInput.value = n ? `${state.stepIdx + 1} / ${n}` : \"0 / 0\";\n    \n    // Candidate display matches Status: position in the cycle pool (still-open + just-rejected)\n    const cand = candidateCycleInfo(step);\n    candidateInput.value = cand.total\n      ? `${cand.displayIdx} / ${cand.total}`\n      : \"0 / 0\";\n    if (mobileStepBackBtn) {\n      mobileStepBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (state.prefixIdx === 0 && state.stepIdx === 0);\n    }\n    if (mobileStepForwardBtn) {\n      const atLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - function applyComparePayload(data) {\n    const layersIn = data.layers || {};\n    const algo = data.algorithm || data.metrics?.algorithm || null;\n    if (!state.compare) {\n      state.compare = {\n Try again in a moment.\";\n    try {\n      const text = await resp.text();\n      if (!text) return fallback;\n      try {\n        const data = JSON.parse(text);\n        return plainUserError(data.error || fallback);\n      } catch {\n        return plainUserError(text.length <= 200 ? text : fallback);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      return fallback;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function plainUserError(message) {\n    const raw = String(message || \"\").trim();\n    if (!raw) return \"Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.\";\n    const lower = raw.toLowerCase();\n    if (\n      lower.includes(\"binary not found\")\n      || lower.includes(\"binary execution\")\n      || lower.includes(\"simplify failed\")\n      || lower.includes(\"processing timeout\")\n      || /\\/(build|usr|tmp|var)\\//.test(raw)\n      || /\\.cpp|\\.h\\b|traceback|stderr|stack/.test(lower)\n    ) {\n      return \"Could not finish this step. Try again, or pick another trajectory.\";\n    }\n    if (/\\btrace\\b/.test(lower) && /not found/.test(lower)) {\n      return raw.replace(/\\b[Tt]race\\b/g, \"Trajectory\").replace(/ not found/i, \" was not found.\");\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"invalid epsilon\") || lower.includes(\"invalid delta\")) {\n      return \"Match and Grid must be valid numbers.\";\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"unknown curve\") || lower.includes(\"unknown algorithm\") || lower.includes(\"unknown compare method\")) {\n      return \"That Compare or Match error option is not available.\";\n    }\n    if (\n      lower.includes(\"simplified path\")\n      || lower.includes(\"could not simplify\")\n      || lower.includes(\"simplification took too long\")\n    ) {\n      return raw\n        .replace(/simplified path/gi, \"green path\")\n        .replace(/Could not simplify this trajectory/gi, \"Could not build the green path for this trajectory\")\n        .replace(/Simplification took too long/gi, \"Building the green path took too long\");\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"lssd\") || lower.includes(\"baseline parameter\")) {\n      return \"Compare settings must be valid numbers.\";\n    }\n    if (lower === \"failed\" || lower === \"unavailable\") {\n      return \"unavailable\";\n    }\n    return raw;\n  }\n\n  function isSampleTraceId() {\n    return currentTraceId !== null\n      && [51, 52, 53].includes(Number.parseInt(currentTraceId, 10));\n  }\n\n  function applySampleTraceYOffset(parsed) {\n    if (!isSampleTraceId()) return;\n    const Y_OFFSET = 500;\n    if (parsed.bbox) {\n      parsed.bbox[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n      parsed.bbox[3] += Y_OFFSET;\n    }\n    if (parsed.stream) {\n      parsed.stream.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        if (pfx.p0) pfx.p0[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n        if (pfx.S) pfx.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        if (pfx.output) {\n          pfx.output.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        }\n        if (pfx.steps) {\n          pfx.steps.forEach((step) => {\n            if (step.pi) step.pi[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n            if (step.Gi) step.Gi.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n            if (step.candidates) {\n              step.candidates.forEach((cand) => {\n                if (cand.F) cand.F.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.F_Si) cand.F_Si.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.S) cand.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.rays) cand.rays.forEach((ray) => ray.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; }));\n              });\n            }\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  function applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(pfx) {\n    if (!isSampleTraceId()) return;\n    const Y_OFFSET = 500;\n    if (pfx.P) pfx.P.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n    if (pfx.p0) pfx.p0[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n    if (pfx.S) pfx.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n    if (pfx.output) pfx.output.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n    if (pfx.steps) {\n      pfx.steps.forEach((step) => {\n        if (step.pi) step.pi[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n        if (step.Gi) step.Gi.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n            if (cand.S) cand.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n            if (cand.rays) cand.rays.forEach((ray) => ray.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; }));\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  function setTopBarTraceStatus(message) {\n    uploadStatus.className = \"sub upload-status-loading\";\n    uploadStatus.innerHTML = `<span class=\"button-spinner\" aria-hidden=\"true\"></span><span>${message}</span>`;\n  }\n\n  function clearTopBarTraceStatus() {\n    uploadStatus.className = \"sub\";\n  }\n\n  function currentTrajectoryLabel() {\n    if (currentFile && currentFile.name) return currentFile.name;\n    const id = currentTraceId || (traceSelect && traceSelect.value) || \"\";\n    if (id && traceSelect) {\n      const opt = Array.from(traceSelect.options).find((o) => String(o.value) === String(id));\n      const label = opt && opt.textContent ? opt.textContent.trim() : \"\";\n      if (label) return label;\n    }\n    if (id) return `Trajectory ${id}`;\n    return \"\";\n  }\n\n  function setAppTitle(label) {\n    if (!appTitleEl) return;\n    const text = (label && String(label).trim()) || APP_TITLE;\n    appTitleEl.textContent = text;\n    if (text !== APP_TITLE) appTitleEl.title = text;\n    else appTitleEl.removeAttribute(\"title\");\n  }\n\n  function enterMobileTraceLayout() {\n    if (!isMobileUI()) return;\n    document.body.classList.add(\"trace-loaded-mobile\");\n    if (headerBody && headerBody.classList.contains(\"open\")) closeHeader();\n    renderParamsBarPreview();\n    resizeCanvas();\n  }\n\n  function statusIndexLabels() {\n    return { p: \"start point\", vi: \"current point\" };\n  }\n\n  function typesetStatus(_el) {\n    // Status uses plain labels only; Try a newer browser.\");\n    }\n\n    const reader = resp.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = \"\";\n    let sawDone = false;\n    let sawHeader = false;\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n\n      let newlineIdx;\n      while ((newlineIdx = buffer.indexOf(\"\\n\")) >= 0) {\n        const line = buffer.slice(0, newlineIdx).trim();\n        buffer = buffer.slice(newlineIdx + 1);\n        if (!line) continue;\n\n        let msg;\n        try {\n          msg = JSON.parse(line);\n        } catch (e) {\n          throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n        }\n\n        // Batch JSON accidentally delivered as one NDJSON line.\n        if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = msg;\n          initTraceUI();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n          throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n        }\n        if (msg.type === \"header\") {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = {\n            eps: msg.eps,\n            delta: msg.delta,\n            grid_val: msg.grid_val,\n            r_val: msg.r_val,\n            expected_frechet: msg.expected_frechet,\n            bbox: msg.bbox,\n            stream: msg.stream,\n            prefixes: [],\n            simplified: null,\n            time_ms: null,\n          };\n          sawHeader = true;\n          state.prefixIdx = 0;\n          state.stepIdx = 0;\n          initTraceUI();\n          fitToData();\n          renderBootstrapStatus(state.trace);\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(total ? `Loading points 0 / ${total}…` : \"Loading points…\");\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"prefix\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          const prefix = msg.data;\n          applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(prefix);\n          state.trace.prefixes.push(prefix);\n          if (state.prefixIdx === 0 && prefix.steps.length > 0) {\n            state.stepIdx = 0;\n          }\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            const loaded = Math.min((prefix.end_idx ?? 0) + 1, total || Infinity);\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(\n              total\n                ? `Loading points ${loaded} / ${total}…`\n                : `Loading points ${loaded}…`\n            );\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"done\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          state.trace.time_ms = msg.time_ms;\n          state.trace.simplified = msg.simplified;\n          if (isSampleTraceId() && state.trace.simplified) {\n            state.trace.simplified.forEach((p) => { p[1] += 500; });\n          }\n          state.trace.frechet_distance = msg.frechet_distance ?? null;\n          sawDone = true;\n          renderParamsBar();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const trailing = buffer.trim();\n    if (trailing) {\n      let msg;\n      try {\n        msg = JSON.parse(trailing);\n      } catch (e) {\n        throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n        applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n        state.trace = msg;\n        initTraceUI();\n        finalizeTraceLoad();\n        return;\n      }\n      if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n        throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!sawDone) {\n      if (!sawHeader) {\n        throw new Error(\"No data received from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      throw new Error(\"Loading stopped before the trajectory finished.\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  function loadTraceText(text, name) {\n    let parsed;\n    try {\n      const sizeKB = (text.length / 1024).toFixed(0);\n      console.log(`[Client] Starting JSON.parse of ${sizeKB}KB string...`);\n      uploadStatus.textContent = \"Reading trajectory…\";\n      uploadStatus.style.color = \"#e8c547\";\n      \n      const parseStart = performance.now();\n      parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n      const parseTime = ((performance.now() - parseStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);\n      console.log(`[Client] JSON.parse completed in ${parseTime}s`);\n    } catch (e) {\n      alert(\"This file could not be read as a trajectory.   if (Number.isFinite(display) && display > 0) {\n        state.baselineLssd = lssdRawFromDisplay(display);\n        syncBaselineLssdInputs();\n      }\n    });\n  }\n  onBaselineLssdChange(baselineLssdInput);\n  onBaselineLssdChange(headerBaselineLssdInput);\n\n  function onPairedNumberChange(input, key, validate) {\n    if (!input) return;\n {\n    resultsPanelOpen.addEventListener(\"click\", () => openResultsPanel());\n  }\n  if (resultsPanelClose) {\n    resultsPanelClose.addEventListener(\"click\", () => closeResultsPanel());\n  }\n  if (resultsPanelBackdrop) {\n    resultsPanelBackdrop.addEventListener(\"click\", () => {\n      if (document.body.classList.contains(\"results-panel-resizing\")) return;\n      closeResultsPanel();\n    });\n  }\n\n  // Adjustable Results panel width.\n  if (resultsPanel && resultsPanelResizer) {\n    const storedWidth = Number.parseFloat(localStorage.getItem(\"resultsPanelWidth\") || \"\");\n    if (Number.isFinite(storedWidth) && storedWidth >= 260) {\n      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(\"--results-panel-width\", `${storedWidth}px`);\n    }\n    let resizing = false;\n    let startX = 0;\n    let startWidth = 0;\n    const onMove = (e) => {\n      if (!resizing) return;\n      const dx = e.clientX - startX;\n      const maxW = Math.min(window.innerWidth * 0.8, 720);\n      const next = Math.max(260, Math.min(maxW, startWidth + dx));\n      document.documentElement.style.setProperty(\"--results-panel-width\", `${next}px`);\n    };\n    const onUp = () => {\n      if window.removeEventListener(\"pointerup\", onUp);\n      const raw = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(\"--results-panel-width\").trim();\n      const px = window.addEventListener(\"pointerup\", onUp);\n    });\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Drawing helpers\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function drawPolyline(pts, close) {\n    if (!pts || pts.length < 2) return;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    const [x0, y0] = worldToScreen(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);\n    ctx.moveTo(x0, y0);\n    for (let i = 1; i < pts.length; ++i) {\n      const [x, y] = worldToScreen(pts[i][0], pts[i][1]);\n      ctx.lineTo(x, y);\n    }\n    if (close) ctx.closePath();\n  }\n\n  function fillPolygon(pts, fillStyle, strokeStyle, lineWidth) {\n    if (!pts || pts.length < 3) return;\n    drawPolyline(pts, true);\n    if (fillStyle) { ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle; ctx.fill(); }\n    if (strokeStyle) {\n      ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n      ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1.5;\n      ctx.stroke();\n    }\n  }\n\n  function strokePath(pts, strokeStyle, lineWidth) {\n    drawPolyline(pts, false);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n    ctx.lineWidth = lineWidth || 1.5;\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n\n  // Ray-casting point-in-polygon (world coords). Returns true if pt is inside poly.\n  function pointInPolygon(pt, poly) {\n    if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return false;\n    const [x, y] = pt;\n    let inside = false;\n    for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {\n      const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];\n      if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi))\n        inside = !inside;\n    }\n    return inside;\n  }\n\n  function dot(p, radius, fillStyle, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n    if (fillStyle) { ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle; ctx.fill(); }\n    if (strokeStyle) { ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke(); }\n  }\n\n  function cross(p, radius, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y - radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + radius);\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y + radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y - radius);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Axis ticks\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function isMobileUI() {\n    return window.matchMedia(\"(max-width: 720px)\").matches;\n  }\n\n  function drawAxisTicks() {\n    const t = state.trace;\n    if (!t || !t.bbox) return;\n    const showCoordLabels = !isMobileUI();\n\n    const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = t.bbox;\n    const xRange = xmax - xmin;\n    const yRange = ymax - ymin;\n\n    // Determine tick spacing based on data size\n    const getTickSpacing = (range) => {\n      const roughTicks = 8;\n      const roughSpacing = range / roughTicks;\n      const magnitude = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(roughSpacing)));\n      const normalized = roughSpacing / magnitude;\n      let nice;\n      if (normalized < 1.5) nice = 1;\n      else if (normalized < 3) nice = 2;\n      else if (normalized < 7) nice = 5;\n      else nice = 10;\n      return nice * magnitude;\n    };\n\n    const xSpacing = getTickSpacing(xRange);\n    const ySpacing = getTickSpacing(yRange);\n\n    // Position axes at the data bounds instead of world origin (0,0)\n    const xAxisY = ymin;\n    const yAxisX = xmin;\n\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#444\";\n    ctx.fillStyle = \"#999\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.font = \"11px monospace\";\n    ctx.textAlign = \"center\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"top\";\n\n    // X-axis ticks\n    const xStart = Math.ceil(xmin / xSpacing) * xSpacing;\n    for (let x = xStart; x <= xmax; x += xSpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(x, xAxisY);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy - 5);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy + 5);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(x.toFixed(0), sx, sy + 8);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Y-axis ticks\n    ctx.textAlign = \"right\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"middle\";\n    const yStart = Math.ceil(ymin / ySpacing) * ySpacing;\n    for (let y = yStart; y <= ymax; y += ySpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, y);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx - 5, sy);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx + 5, sy);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(y.toFixed(0), sx - 8, sy);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Draw axes at the data bounds\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#666\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    // X-axis at bottom of data\n    const [x0Left, y0] = worldToScreen(xmin, xAxisY);\n    const [x0Right, _] = worldToScreen(xmax, xAxisY);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0Left, y0);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0Right, y0);\n    ctx.stroke();\n    // Y-axis at left of data\n    const [x0, y0Bottom] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymin);\n    const [__, y0Top] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymax);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0, y0Bottom);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0, y0Top);\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    // Draw bounding box (always visible, solid lines)\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#888\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    const [bx1, by1] = worldToScreen(xmin, ymin);\n    const [bx2, by2] = worldToScreen(xmax, ymax);\n    ctx.strokeRect(bx1, by2, bx2 - bx1, by1 - by2);\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Main render\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function render() {\n    resizeCanvas();\n    const rect = canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);\n    renderStatus();\n\n    const t = state.trace;\n    const traceLoading = document.body.classList.contains(\"trace-loading\");\n    if (!t) {\n      if (isMobileUI()) {\n        for (const btn of mobileTransportButtons) {\n          if (btn) btn.disabled = true;\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const traceNotReady = traceLoading && (!t.prefixes || t.prefixes.length === 0);\n\n    const pfx = currentPrefix();\n    const step = currentStep();\n\n    // Draw axis ticks\n    drawAxisTicks();\n\n    // Update navigation input fields\n    segmentInput.value = `${state.prefixIdx + 1} / ${t.prefixes.length}`;\n    const n = pfx ? pfx.steps.length : 0;\n    stepInput.value = n ? `${state.stepIdx + 1} / ${n}` : \"0 / 0\";\n    \n    // Candidate display matches Status: position in the cycle pool (still-open + just-rejected)\n    const cand = candidateCycleInfo(step);\n    candidateInput.value = cand.total\n      ? `${cand.displayIdx} / ${cand.total}`\n      : \"0 / 0\";\n    if (mobileStepBackBtn) {\n      mobileStepBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (state.prefixIdx === 0 && state.stepIdx === 0);\n    }\n    if (mobileStepForwardBtn) {\n      const atLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n      mobileStepForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (atLastPrefix && state.stepIdx >= n - 1);\n    }\n    const hasCandidates = Boolean(step && step.candidates.length);\n    if (mobileCandidateBackBtn) mobileCandidateBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || !hasCandidates;\n    if (mobileCandidateForwardBtn) mobileCandidateForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || !hasCandidates;\n    if (mobilePlayBtn) mobilePlayBtn.disabled = traceNotReady;\n    const prefixCount = t.prefixes.length;\n    if (mobileSegmentBackBtn) {\n      mobileSegmentBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || state.prefixIdx <= 0;\n    }\n    if (mobileSegmentForwardBtn) {\n      mobileSegmentForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || state.prefixIdx >= prefixCount - 1;\n    }\n\n    // 1. Full input stream (faint polyline + small filled dots).\n    const showOriginal = toggles.stream\n      ? toggles.stream.checked\n      : !!state.resultVisible.original;\n    if (showOriginal) {\n      strokePath(t.stream, \"#3d4456\", 1.25);\n      \n      // Collect all simplified output points to avoid drawing them twice\n      const simplifiedPoints = new Set();\n      for (let i = 0; i < state.prefixIdx; ++i) {\n        const pfxOutput = t.prefixes[i].output;\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfxOutput[0][0]},${pfxOutput[0][1]}`);\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfxOutput[1][0]},${pfxOutput[1][1]}`);\n      }\n      if (pfx && step && state.stepIdx === pfx.steps.length - 1) {\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfx.output[0][0]},${pfx.output[0][1]}`);\n        // Do NOT add output[1] if this is the very last prefix - that's the trajectory endpoint\n        const isLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n        if (!isLastPrefix) {\n          simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfx.output[1][0]},${pfx.output[1][1]}`);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // Draw stream dots, but skip those that are part of simplified output\n      for (const p of t.stream) {\n        const key = `${p[0]},${p[1]}`;\n        if (!simplifiedPoints.has(key)) {\n          dot(p, 0.8, \"#4a5266\", null);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. Simplified output committed so far (all prior prefixes' outputs).\n    if (toggles.simplified.checked) {\n      const committed = [];\n      for (let i = 0; i < state.prefixIdx; ++i) {\n        committed.push(t.prefixes[i].output[0], t.prefixes[i].output[1]);\n      }\n      // Do NOT push pfx.output[0] during mid-prefix steps: it coincides with a\n      // P-grid corner, so a green dot would foreshadow which candidate \"wins\".\n      // Exception: once we are on the last step of this prefix the computation is\n      // complete, so we can safely reveal the output segment (this also ensures the\n      // final prefix's segment is shown — it would otherwise never be promoted into\n      // a \"prior\" prefix by advancing to a non-existent next prefix).\n      if (pfx && step && state.stepIdx === pfx.steps.length - 1 && \n                                            state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n        const numToExclude = isAtFinalStepOfFinalPrefix ? 1 : 0;\n        const dotsToShow = committed.length > numToExclude ? committed.slice(0, committed.length - numToExclude) : [];\n        for (const p of dotsToShow) dot(p, 1.8, \"#3ddc97\", null);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Final full green path (accordion: This run → Full green path).\n    if (state.resultVisible.simplify && t.simplified && t.simplified.length >= 2) {\n      strokePath(t.simplified, \"#3ddc97\", 2.5);\n      for (const p of t.simplified) dot(p, 1.7, \"#3ddc97\", null);\n    }\n    // Baseline result curves (one dashed overlay per selected algorithm).\n    for (const algo of BASELINE_ORDER) {\n      if (!state.resultVisible[algo] || !state.compare?.layers?.[algo]) continue;\n      const basePts = state.compare.layers[algo];\n      const color = BASELINE_COLORS[algo] || \"#f472b6\";\n      ctx.setLineDash([7, 4]);\n      strokePath(basePts, color, 2.25);\n      ctx.setLineDash([]);\n      for (const p of basePts) dot(p, 1.6, color, null);\n    }\n\n    if (pfx) {\n      // Determine \"best\" candidate index for this step (the one the buffer\n      // was pulled from — mirrors the reverse scan in get_longest_stab).\n      let bestIdx = -1;\n      if (step) {\n        for (let i = step.candidates.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {\n          const c = step.candidates[i];\n          if (!c.alive || !c.S || c.S.length === 0) continue;\n          bestIdx = i;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 4. δ-balls — each independently toggleable.\n      {\n        const r = t.r_val;\n        const drawBall = (cx, cy, fillColor, strokeColor, lw) => {\n          const [scx, scy] = worldToScreen(cx, cy);\n          const rScreen = r * state.cam.scale;\n          ctx.beginPath();\n          ctx.arc(scx, scy, rScreen, 0, 2 * Math.PI);\n          if (fillColor) { ctx.fillStyle = fillColor; ctx.fill(); }\n          ctx.strokeStyle = strokeColor;\n          ctx.lineWidth = lw;\n          ctx.stroke();\n        };\n        // Ball at p0: the ball whose grid corners define the P anchor set.\n        if (toggles[\"ball-p0\"].checked) {\n          drawBall(pfx.p0[0], pfx.p0[1], \"rgba(196,122,255,0.07)\", \"rgba(196,122,255,0.6)\", 1.5);\n        }\n        // Ball at v_i: the ball that conv(G_i) must cover at this step.\n        if (step && step.pi && toggles[\"ball-pi\"].checked) {\n          drawBall(step.pi[0], step.pi[1], \"rgba(255,122,232,0.07)\", \"rgba(255,122,232,0.85)\", 1.75);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 4b. G_i delta-disk convex hull for the point being consumed this step.\n      if (step && toggles.Gi.checked) {\n        fillPolygon(step.Gi, null, \"#e8c547\", 1.75);\n      }\n\n      // 5/6/7/8/10. Candidate display — single shared cycle pool.\n      // Cycle pool = alive + just-died (dead but have F data from this step).\n      // Previously-dead (no F this step) are dimmed but not cycled through.\n      if (step) {\n        const allCandidates = step.candidates\n          .map((c, i) => ({ ...c, originalIdx: i }));\n\n        // 'alive' | 'justDied' (dead but has F this step) | 'dead' (previously dead)\n        const statusOf = c =>\n          c.alive ?    if (c.F.length !== 4 || !state.trace) return false;\n              const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = state.trace.bbox;\n              const corners = [[xmin,ymin],[xmax,ymin],[xmax,ymax],[xmin,ymax]];\n              return c.F.every(fp =>\n                corners.some(co =>\n                  Math.abs(fp[0]-co[0]) < 1 && Math.abs(fp[1]-co[1]) < 1));\n            })();\n\n            if (status === 'alive' && isBbox) {\n              ctx.save();\n              ctx.strokeStyle = \"rgba(79,157,255,0.7)\";\n              ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n              ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);\n              fillPolygon(c.F, null, \"rgba(79,157,255,0.7)\", 1.5);\n              ctx.setLineDash([]);\n              ctx.restore();\n            } else {\n              fillPolygon(c.F,\n                isBbox ? null : col.fFill,\n                isBbox ? col.fStroke.replace(/[\\d.]+\\)$/, \"0.45)\") : col.fStroke,\n                col.lw);\n            }\n\n = col.lw;\n              ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);\n              const [asx, asy] = worldToScreen(ax, ay);\n              for (const tp of [t1, t2]) {\n                const [tx, ty] = worldToScreen(tp[0], tp[1]);\n                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(asx, asy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.stroke();\n              }\n              ctx.setLineDash([]);\n              ctx.restore();\n            }\n          }\n\n          // F_Si wedge for the viewed candidate\n          if (toggles[\"F-Si\"].checked && c.F_Si && c.F_Si.length >= 3) {\n            const isBbox = (() => {\n              if (c.F_Si.length !== 4 || !state.trace) return false;\n              const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = state.trace.bbox;\n              const corners = [[xmin,ymin],[xmax,ymin],[xmax,ymax],[xmin,ymax]];\n              return c.F_Si.every(fp =>\n                corners.some(co =>\n                  Math.abs(fp[0]-co[0]) < 1 && Math.abs(fp[1]-co[1]) < 1));\n            })();\n\n            // Use cyan color for F_Si\n            const fSiCol = {\n              fFill: \"rgba(34,211,238,0.12)\",\n              fStroke: \"rgba(34,211,238,0.85)\",\n              ray: \"rgba(34,211,238,0.6)\",\n              lw: 1.5\n            };\n\n            if (status === 'alive' && isBbox) {\n              ctx.save();\n              ctx.strokeStyle = (failed) {\n        delete state.compare.layers[algo];\n        state.resultVisible[algo] = false;\n      }\n      state.compare.metricsByAlgo[algo] = {\n        label: data.metrics?.baseline_label || \"Compare needs a preloaded trajectory. `${baselineAlgoLabel(algo)}: ${plainUserError(data.baseline_error || data.dots_error)}`\n          );\n        } else {\n          ran.push(algo);\n        }\n        if (applyComparePayload(data)) setBaselineStatus(plainUserError(err.message) || \"Compare run failed\", \"error\");\n    } finally {\n      setCompareRunBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function startBaselineFrechet(algo) {\n    if Try again in a moment.\";\n    try {\n      const text = await resp.text();\n      if (!text) return fallback;\n      try {\n        const data = JSON.parse(text);\n        return plainUserError(data.error || fallback);\n      } catch {\n        return plainUserError(text.length <= 200 ? text : fallback);\n      }\n    } catch {\n      return fallback;\n    }\n  }\n\n  function plainUserError(message) {\n    const raw = String(message || \"\").trim();\n    if (!raw) return \"Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.\";\n    const lower = raw.toLowerCase();\n    if (\n      lower.includes(\"binary not found\")\n      || lower.includes(\"binary execution\")\n      || lower.includes(\"simplify failed\")\n      || lower.includes(\"processing timeout\")\n      || /\\/(build|usr|tmp|var)\\//.test(raw)\n      || /\\.cpp|\\.h\\b|traceback|stderr|stack/.test(lower)\n    ) {\n      return \"Could not finish this step. Try again, or pick another trajectory.\";\n    }\n    if (/\\btrace\\b/.test(lower) && /not found/.test(lower)) {\n      return raw.replace(/\\b[Tt]race\\b/g, \"Trajectory\").replace(/ not found/i, \" was not found.\");\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"invalid epsilon\") || lower.includes(\"invalid delta\")) {\n      return \"Match and Grid must be valid numbers.\";\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"unknown curve\") || lower.includes(\"unknown algorithm\") || lower.includes(\"unknown compare method\")) {\n      return \"That Compare or Match error option is not available.\";\n    }\n    if (\n      lower.includes(\"simplified path\")\n      || lower.includes(\"could not simplify\")\n      || lower.includes(\"simplification took too long\")\n    ) {\n      return raw\n        .replace(/simplified path/gi, \"green path\")\n        .replace(/Could not simplify this trajectory/gi, \"Could not build the green path for this trajectory\")\n        .replace(/Simplification took too long/gi, \"Building the green path took too long\");\n    }\n    if (lower.includes(\"lssd\") || lower.includes(\"baseline parameter\")) {\n      return \"Compare settings must be valid numbers.\";\n    }\n    if (lower === \"failed\" || lower === \"unavailable\") {\n      return \"unavailable\";\n    }\n    return raw;\n  }\n\n  function isSampleTraceId() {\n    return currentTraceId !== null\n      && [51, 52, 53].includes(Number.parseInt(currentTraceId, 10));\n  }\n\n  function applySampleTraceYOffset(parsed) {\n    if (!isSampleTraceId()) return;\n    const Y_OFFSET = 500;\n    if (parsed.bbox) {\n      parsed.bbox[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n      parsed.bbox[3] += Y_OFFSET;\n    }\n    if (parsed.stream) {\n      parsed.stream.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        if (pfx.p0) pfx.p0[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n        if (pfx.S) pfx.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        if (pfx.output) {\n          pfx.output.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n        }\n        if (pfx.steps) {\n          pfx.steps.forEach((step) => {\n            if (step.pi) step.pi[1] += Y_OFFSET;\n            if (step.Gi) step.Gi.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n            if (step.candidates) {\n              step.candidates.forEach((cand) => {\n                if (cand.F) cand.F.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.F_Si) cand.F_Si.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.S) cand.S.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; });\n                if (cand.rays) cand.rays.forEach((ray) => ray.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; }));\n              });\n            }\n          });\n        }\n      });\n    }\n  }\n\n  function applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(pfx) {\n    if (!isSampleTraceId()) return;\n    const Y_OFFSET = 500;\n    if (pfx.P) pfx.P.forEach((p) => { p[1] += Y_OFFSET; Try a newer browser.\");\n    }\n\n    const reader = resp.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = \"\";\n    let sawDone = false;\n    let sawHeader = false;\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n\n      let newlineIdx;\n      while ((newlineIdx = buffer.indexOf(\"\\n\")) >= 0) {\n        const line = buffer.slice(0, newlineIdx).trim();\n        buffer = buffer.slice(newlineIdx + 1);\n        if (!line) continue;\n\n        let msg;\n        try {\n          msg = JSON.parse(line);\n        } catch (e) {\n          throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n        }\n\n        // Batch JSON accidentally delivered as one NDJSON line.\n        if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = msg;\n          initTraceUI();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n          throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n        }\n        if (msg.type === \"header\") {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = {\n            eps: msg.eps,\n            delta: msg.delta,\n            grid_val: msg.grid_val,\n            r_val: msg.r_val,\n            expected_frechet: msg.expected_frechet,\n            bbox: msg.bbox,\n            stream: msg.stream,\n            prefixes: [],\n            simplified: null,\n            time_ms: null,\n          };\n          sawHeader = true;\n          state.prefixIdx = 0;\n          state.stepIdx = 0;\n          initTraceUI();\n          fitToData();\n          renderBootstrapStatus(state.trace);\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(total ? `Loading points 0 / ${total}…` : \"Loading points…\");\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"prefix\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          const prefix = msg.data;\n          applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(prefix);\n          state.trace.prefixes.push(prefix);\n          if (state.prefixIdx === 0 && prefix.steps.length > 0) {\n            state.stepIdx = 0;\n          }\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            const loaded = Math.min((prefix.end_idx ?? 0) + 1, total || Infinity);\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(\n              total\n                ? `Loading points ${loaded} / ${total}…`\n                : `Loading points ${loaded}…`\n            );\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"done\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          state.trace.time_ms = msg.time_ms;\n          state.trace.simplified = msg.simplified;\n          if (isSampleTraceId() && state.trace.simplified) {\n            state.trace.simplified.forEach((p) => { p[1] += 500; });\n          }\n          state.trace.frechet_distance = msg.frechet_distance ?? null;\n          sawDone = true;\n          renderParamsBar();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const trailing = buffer.trim();\n    if (trailing) {\n      let msg;\n      try {\n        msg = JSON.parse(trailing);\n      } catch (e) {\n        throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n        applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n        state.trace = msg;\n        initTraceUI();\n        finalizeTraceLoad();\n        return;\n      }\n      if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n        throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!sawDone) {\n      if (!sawHeader) {\n        throw new Error(\"No data received from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      throw new Error(\"Loading stopped before the trajectory finished.\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  function loadTraceText(text, name) {\n    let parsed;\n    try {\n      const sizeKB = (text.length / 1024).toFixed(0);\n      console.log(`[Client] Starting JSON.parse of ${sizeKB}KB string...`);\n      uploadStatus.textContent = \"Reading trajectory…\";\n      uploadStatus.style.color = \"#e8c547\";\n      \n      const parseStart = performance.now();\n      parsed = JSON.parse(text);\n      const parseTime = ((performance.now() - parseStart) / 1000).toFixed(2);\n      console.log(`[Client] JSON.parse completed in ${parseTime}s`);\n    } catch (e) {\n      alert(\"This file could not be read as a trajectory. Returns true if pt is inside poly.\n  function pointInPolygon(pt, poly) {\n    if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return false;\n    const [x, y] = pt;\n    let inside = false;\n    for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {\n      const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];\n      if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi))\n        inside = !inside;\n    }\n    return inside;\n  }\n\n  function dot(p, radius, fillStyle, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n    if (fillStyle) { ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle; ctx.fill(); }\n    if (strokeStyle) { ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke(); }\n  }\n\n  function cross(p, radius, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y - radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y + radius);\n    ctx.moveTo(x - radius, y + radius); ctx.lineTo(x + radius, y - radius);\n    ctx.stroke();\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Axis ticks\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function isMobileUI() {\n    return window.matchMedia(\"(max-width: 720px)\").matches;\n  }\n\n  function drawAxisTicks() {\n    const t = state.trace;\n    if (!t || !t.bbox) return;\n    const showCoordLabels = !isMobileUI();\n\n    const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = t.bbox;\n    const xRange = xmax - xmin;\n    const yRange = ymax - ymin;\n\n    // Determine tick spacing based on data size\n    const getTickSpacing = (range) => {\n      const roughTicks = 8;\n      const roughSpacing = range / roughTicks;\n      const magnitude = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(roughSpacing)));\n      const normalized = roughSpacing / magnitude;\n      let nice;\n      if (normalized < 1.5) nice = 1;\n      else if (normalized < 3) nice = 2;\n      else if (normalized < 7) nice = 5;\n      else nice = 10;\n      return nice * magnitude;\n    };\n\n    const xSpacing = getTickSpacing(xRange);\n    const ySpacing = getTickSpacing(yRange);\n\n    // Position axes at the data bounds instead of world origin (0,0)\n    const xAxisY = ymin;\n    const yAxisX = xmin;\n\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#444\";\n    ctx.fillStyle = \"#999\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.font = \"11px monospace\";\n    ctx.textAlign = \"center\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"top\";\n\n    // X-axis ticks\n    const xStart = Math.ceil(xmin / xSpacing) * xSpacing;\n    for (let x = xStart; x <= xmax; x += xSpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(x, xAxisY);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy - 5);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx, sy + 5);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(x.toFixed(0), sx, sy + 8);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Y-axis ticks\n    ctx.textAlign = \"right\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"middle\";\n    const yStart = Math.ceil(ymin / ySpacing) * ySpacing;\n    for (let y = yStart; y <= ymax; y += ySpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, y);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx - 5, sy);\n      ctx.lineTo(sx + 5, sy);\n      ctx.stroke();\n      if (showCoordLabels) {\n        ctx.fillText(y.toFixed(0), sx - 8, sy);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Draw axes at the data bounds\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#666\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    // X-axis at bottom of data\n    const [x0Left, y0] = worldToScreen(xmin, xAxisY);\n    const [x0Right, _] = worldToScreen(xmax, xAxisY);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0Left, y0);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0Right, y0);\n    ctx.stroke();\n    // Y-axis at left of data\n    const [x0, y0Bottom] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymin);\n    const [__, y0Top] = worldToScreen(yAxisX, ymax);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x0, y0Bottom);\n    ctx.lineTo(x0, y0Top);\n    ctx.stroke();\n\n    // Draw bounding box (always visible, solid lines)\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#888\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    const [bx1, by1] = worldToScreen(xmin, ymin);\n    const [bx2, by2] = worldToScreen(xmax, ymax);\n    ctx.strokeRect(bx1, by2, bx2 - bx1, by1 - by2);\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Main render\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function render() {\n    resizeCanvas();\n    const rect = canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);\n    renderStatus();\n\n    const t = state.trace;\n    const traceLoading = document.body.classList.contains(\"trace-loading\");\n    if (!t) {\n      if (isMobileUI()) {\n        for (const btn of mobileTransportButtons) {\n          if (btn) btn.disabled = true;\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const traceNotReady = traceLoading && (!t.prefixes || t.prefixes.length === 0);\n\n    const pfx = currentPrefix();\n    const step = currentStep();\n\n    // Draw axis ticks\n    drawAxisTicks();\n\n    // Update navigation input fields\n    segmentInput.value = `${state.prefixIdx + 1} / ${t.prefixes.length}`;\n    const n = pfx ? pfx.steps.length : 0;\n    stepInput.value = n ? `${state.stepIdx + 1} / ${n}` : \"0 / 0\";\n    \n    // Candidate display matches Status: position in the cycle pool (still-open + just-rejected)\n    const cand = candidateCycleInfo(step);\n    candidateInput.value = cand.total\n      ? `${cand.displayIdx} / ${cand.total}`\n      : \"0 / 0\";\n    if (mobileStepBackBtn) {\n      mobileStepBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (state.prefixIdx === 0 && state.stepIdx === 0);\n    }\n    if (mobileStepForwardBtn) {\n      const atLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n      mobileStepForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (atLastPrefix && state.stepIdx >= n - 1);\n    }\n    const hasCandidates = Boolean(step && step.candidates.length);\n    if (mobileCandidateBackBtn) mobileCandidateBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || !hasCandidates;\n    if (mobileCandidateForwardBtn) mobileCandidateForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || !hasCandidates;\n    if (mobilePlayBtn) mobilePlayBtn.disabled = traceNotReady;\n    const prefixCount = t.prefixes.length;\n    if (mobileSegmentBackBtn) {\n      mobileSegmentBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || state.prefixIdx <= 0;\n    }\n    if (mobileSegmentForwardBtn) {\n      mobileSegmentForwardBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || state.prefixIdx >= prefixCount - 1;\n    }\n\n    // 1. Full input stream (faint polyline + small filled dots).\n    const showOriginal = toggles.stream\n      ? toggles.stream.checked\n      : !!state.resultVisible.original;\n    if (showOriginal) {\n      strokePath(t.stream, \"#3d4456\", 1.25);\n      \n      // Collect all simplified output points to avoid drawing them twice\n      const simplifiedPoints = new Set();\n      for (let i = 0; i < state.prefixIdx; ++i) {\n        const pfxOutput = t.prefixes[i].output;\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfxOutput[0][0]},${pfxOutput[0][1]}`);\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfxOutput[1][0]},${pfxOutput[1][1]}`);\n      }\n      if (pfx && step && state.stepIdx === pfx.steps.length - 1) {\n        simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfx.output[0][0]},${pfx.output[0][1]}`);\n        // Do NOT add output[1] if this is the very last prefix - that's the trajectory endpoint\n        const isLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n        if (!isLastPrefix) {\n          simplifiedPoints.add(`${pfx.output[1][0]},${pfx.output[1][1]}`);\n        }\n      }\n      \n      // Draw stream dots, but skip those that are part of simplified output\n      for (const p of t.stream) {\n        const key = `${p[0]},${p[1]}`;\n        if (!simplifiedPoints.has(key)) {\n          dot(p, 0.8, \"#4a5266\", null);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 3. Simplified output committed so far (all prior prefixes' outputs).\n    if (toggles.simplified.checked) {\n      const committed = [];\n      for (let i = 0; i < state.prefixIdx; ++i) {\n        committed.push(t.prefixes[i].output[0], t.prefixes[i].output[1]);\n      }\n      // Do NOT push pfx.output[0] during mid-prefix steps: it coincides with a\n      // P-grid corner, so a green dot would foreshadow which candidate \"wins\".\n      // Exception: once we are on the last step of this prefix the computation is\n      // complete, so we can safely reveal the output segment (this also ensures the\n      // final prefix's segment is shown — it would otherwise never be promoted into\n      // a \"prior\" prefix by advancing to a non-existent next prefix).\n      if (pfx && step && state.stepIdx === pfx.steps.length - 1) {\n        committed.push(pfx.output[0], pfx.output[1]);\n      }\n      // Only draw if we have at least 2 points (a complete segment)\n      if (committed.length >= 2) {\n        strokePath(committed, \"#3ddc97\", 2.25);\n        // Show dots for all committed points except the trajectory endpoint\n        // If at the final step of the final prefix, exclude the last point (trajectory endpoint)\n        const isAtFinalStepOfFinalPrefix = pfx && step && \n                                            state.stepIdx === pfx.steps.length - 1 && \n                                            state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length - 1;\n        const numToExclude = isAtFinalStepOfFinalPrefix ? 1 : 0;\n        const dotsToShow = committed.length > numToExclude ? committed.slice(0, committed.length - numToExclude) : [];\n        for (const p of dotsToShow) dot(p, 1.8, \"#3ddc97\", null);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Final full green path (accordion: This run → Full green path).\n    if (state.resultVisible.simplify && t.simplified && t.simplified.length >= 2) {\n      strokePath(t.simplified, \"#3ddc97\", 2.5);\n      for (const p of t.simplified) dot(p, 1.7, \"#3ddc97\", null);\n    }\n    // Baseline result curves (one dashed overlay per selected algorithm).\n    for (const algo of BASELINE_ORDER) {\n      if (!state.resultVisible[algo] || !state.compare?.layers?.[algo]) continue;\n      const basePts = state.compare.layers[algo];\n      const color = BASELINE_COLORS[algo] || \"#f472b6\";\n      ctx.setLineDash([7, 4]);\n      strokePath(basePts, color, 2.25);\n      ctx.setLineDash([]);\n      for (const p of basePts) dot(p, 1.6, color, null);\n    }\n\n    if (pfx) {\n      // Determine \"best\" candidate index for this step (the one the buffer\n      // was pulled from — mirrors the reverse scan in get_longest_stab).\n      let bestIdx = -1;\n      if (step) {\n        for (let i = step.candidates.length - 1; i >= 0; --i) {\n          const c = step.candidates[i];\n          if (!c.alive || !c.S || c.S.length === 0) continue;\n          bestIdx = i;\n          break;\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 4. δ-balls — each independently toggleable.\n      {\n        const r = t.r_val;\n        const drawBall = (cx, cy, fillColor, strokeColor, lw) => {\n          const [scx, scy] = worldToScreen(cx, cy);\n          const rScreen = r * state.cam.scale;\n          ctx.beginPath();\n          ctx.arc(scx, scy, rScreen, 0, 2 * Math.PI);\n          if (fillColor) { ctx.fillStyle = fillColor; ctx.fill(); }\n          ctx.strokeStyle = strokeColor;\n          ctx.lineWidth = lw;\n          ctx.stroke();\n        };\n        // Ball at p0: the ball whose grid corners define the P anchor set.\n        if (toggles[\"ball-p0\"].checked) {\n          drawBall(pfx.p0[0], pfx.p0[1], \"rgba(196,122,255,0.07)\", \"rgba(196,122,255,0.6)\", 1.5);\n        }\n        // Ball at v_i: the ball that conv(G_i) must cover at this step.\n        if (step && step.pi && toggles[\"ball-pi\"].checked) {\n          drawBall(step.pi[0], step.pi[1], \"rgba(255,122,232,0.07)\", \"rgba(255,122,232,0.85)\", 1.75);\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 4b. G_i delta-disk convex hull for the point being consumed this step.\n      if (step && toggles.Gi.checked) {\n        fillPolygon(step.Gi, null, \"#e8c547\", 1.75);\n      }\n\n      // 5/6/7/8/10. Candidate display — single shared cycle pool.\n      // Cycle pool = alive + just-died (dead but have F data from this step).\n      // Previously-dead (no F this step) are dimmed but not cycled through.\n      if (step) {\n        const allCandidates = step.candidates\n          .map((c, i) => ({ ...c, originalIdx: i }));\n\n        // 'alive' | 'justDied' (dead but has F this step) | 'dead' (previously dead)\n        const statusOf = c =>\n          c.alive ? 'alive' : (c.F && c.F.length >= 3 ? 'justDied' : 'dead');\n\n        const COLORS = {\n          alive:    { fFill: \"rgba(79,157,255,0.18)\",  fStroke: \"rgba(79,157,255,0.85)\",  ray: \"rgba(79,157,255,1)\",   lw: 2,    dotR: 3,   dotFill: \"#ff9f43\", dotStroke: \"#ff6b1a\" },\n          justDied: { fFill: \"rgba(255,60,60,0.14)\",    fStroke: \"rgba(255,60,60,0.9)\",    ray: \"rgba(255,60,60,1)\",    lw: 1.75, dotR: 3,   dotFill: \"#ff3c3c\", dotStroke: \"#cc1a1a\" },\n          dead:     { fFill: \"rgba(255,60,60,0.08)\",  fStroke: \"rgba(255,60,60,0.7)\",   ray: \"rgba(255,60,60,0.7)\", lw: 1.5,  dotR: 2.5, dotFill: \"#ff3c3c\", dotStroke: \"#cc1a1a\" },\n        };\n\n        const cyclePool = allCandidates.filter(c => statusOf(c) !== 'dead');\n        const viewedCandidate = cyclePool.length > 0\n          ? cyclePool[state.candidateIdx % cyclePool.length]\n          : null;\n\n        // 5/6. F wedge, tangent rays, S region, anchor highlight.\n        if (viewedCandidate) {\n          const i = viewedCandidate.originalIdx;\n          const c = viewedCandidate;\n          const status = statusOf(c);\n          const col = COLORS[status];\n          const anchor = pfx.P[i];\n\n          if (toggles.F.checked && c.F && c.F.length >= 3) {\n            const isBbox = (() => {\n              if (c.F.length !== 4 || !state.trace) return false;\n              const [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] = state.trace.bbox;\n              const corners = [[xmin,ymin],[xmax,ymin],[xmax,ymax],[xmin,ymax]];\n              return c.F.every(fp =>\n                corners.some(co =>\n                  Math.abs(fp[0]-co[0]) < 1 && Math.abs(fp[1]-co[1]) < 1));\n            })();\n\n            if (status === 'alive' && isBbox) {\n              ctx.save();\n              ctx.strokeStyle = \"rgba(79,157,255,0.7)\";\n              ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n              ctx.setLineDash([6, 4]);\n              fillPolygon(c.F, null, \"rgba(79,157,255,0.7)\", 1.5);\n              ctx.setLineDash([]);\n              ctx.restore();\n            } else {\n              fillPolygon(c.F,\n                isBbox ? null : col.fFill,\n                isBbox ? col.fStroke.replace(/[\\d.]+\\)$/, \"0.45)\") : col.fStroke,\n                col.lw);\n            }\n\n c.F[indexed[gapAfter].ii];\n              const t2 = c.F[indexed[(gapAfter + 1) % indexed.length].ii];\n              ctx.save();\n              ctx.strokeStyle = col.ray;\n              ctx.lineWidth = col.lw;\n              ctx.setLineDash([5, 5]);\n              const [asx, asy] = worldToScreen(ax, ay);\n              for (const tp of [t1, t2]) {\n                const [tx, ty] = worldToScreen(tp[0], tp[1]);\n                ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(asx, asy); ctx.lineTo(tx, ty); ctx.stroke();\n              }\n              ctx.setLineDash([]);\n              ctx.restore();\n            }\n          }\n\n          // F_Si wedge for the viewed candidate\n          if (toggles[\"F-Si\"].checked && c.F_Si && c.F_Si.length >= 3) {\n            const isBbox =           ray: \"rgba(34,211,238,0.6)\",\n              lw: 1.5\n            };\n\n            if (status === 'alive' && isBbox) {\n              ctx.save();\n              ctx.strokeStyle =    if (anchor && c.F_Si.length >= 1 && !pointInPolygon(anchor, c.F_Si)) {\n              const [ax, ay] = [anchor[0], anchor[1]];\n              const angles = c.F_Si.map(sp => Math.atan2(sp[1] - ay, }\n\n  function squishRawFromDisplay(display) {\n    return display / 100;\n  }\n\n  function syncPairedNumberInputs(a, b, value) {\n    const text = String(value);\n    if (a &&   }\n    syncBaselineParamFields();\n  }\n\n  function emptyCompareMessage(colspan) {\n    const msg = compareBlockedByUpload()\n      ? \"Scores appear after Load. }\n\n  function showResultsPanel(hasBaseline) {\n    if (!resultsPanel) return;\n    resultsPanel.hidden = false;\n    document.body.classList.add(\"results-available\");\n    closeResultsPanel();\n\n    if (accordionBaseline) accordionBaseline.open = false;\n    renderBaselineLayerToggles();\n    syncLayerTogglesFromState();\n    syncBaselineParamFields();\n    renderCompareMetrics();\n  }\n\n  function applyComparePayload(data) {\n    const layersIn = data.layers || {};\n    const algo = data.algorithm || data.metrics?.algorithm || null;\n    if (!state.compare) {\n      state.compare = {\n        layers: {},\n        metrics: {},\n        metricsByAlgo: {},\n        frechet: { simplify: null, byAlgo: {} },\n      };\n    }\n    if (layersIn.original) state.compare.layers.original = layersIn.original;\n    if (layersIn.simplify) state.compare.layers.simplify = layersIn.simplify;\n    if (data.metrics) {\n      if (data.metrics.original_points != null) (data.metrics.simplify_core_ms != null) state.compare.metrics.simplify_core_ms = data.metrics.simplify_core_ms;\n    }\n    if (algo && algo !== \"none\") {\n      const failed = !!(data.baseline_error || data.dots_error);\n      const pts = failed ? null : (layersIn[algo] || layersIn.baseline);\n      if (Array.isArray(pts) && pts.length) {\n        const copy = pts.map((p) => [p[0], p[1]]);\n        if (isSampleTraceId()) copy.forEach((p) => { p[1] += 500; });\n        state.compare.layers[algo] = copy;\n        state.resultVisible[algo] = true;\n      } else if (failed) {\n        delete state.compare.layers[algo];\n        state.resultVisible[algo] = false;\n      }\n      state.compare.metricsByAlgo[algo] = {\n        label: data.metrics?.baseline_label || })(),\n      };\n    }\n    return selectedBaselineAlgos().some((a) => Array.isArray(state.compare.layers[a]) && state.compare.layers[a].length > 0);\n  }\n\n  async function loadCompare() {\n    clearCompare({ hideChrome: false });\n    if (!currentTraceId) {\n      if (state.trace) showResultsPanel(false);\n      if (compareBlockedByUpload()) {\n        setBaselineStatus(\n          \"Compare needs a preloaded trajectory. Uploaded files show scores only.\",\n        );\n      }\n      syncBaselineParamFields();\n      return;\n    }\n    try {\n      const resp = await fetch(`/api/trace/${currentTraceId}/compare?algorithm=none`);\n      if (!resp.ok) {\n        if (state.trace) showResultsPanel(false);\n        return;\n      }\n      const data = await resp.json();\n      applyComparePayload(data);\n      showResultsPanel(false);\n      if (selectedBaselineAlgos().length) {\n        setBaselineStatus(`Running selected compare method(s)…`);\n        await runSelectedBaseline();\n      } else {\n        setBaselineStatus(\"Choose one or more compare methods and press Run compare.\");\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn(\"[Compare] Failed to load compare shell:\", err);\n      if (state.trace) showResultsPanel(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  async function runSelectedBaseline() {\n    if (!currentTraceId) {\n      setBaselineStatus(\n        compareBlockedByUpload()\n          ? \"Compare needs a preloaded trajectory. Uploaded files show scores only.\"\n          : \"Load a preloaded trajectory first.\",\n        \"error\"\n      );\n      return;\n    }\n    const algos = selectedBaselineAlgos();\n    if squishRatio = state.baselineSquishRatio;\n    if (algos.includes(\"dots\")) {\n      lssd = readBaselineLssdFromInputs();\n      if (!Number.isFinite(lssd) || lssd <= 0) {\n        setBaselineStatus(\"DOTS budget must be a positive number.\", \"error\");\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n    if (algos.includes(\"dp\")) {\n      dpEps = readPairedNumber(baselineDpEpsInput, return;\n      }\n      state.baselineDpEps = dpEps;\n      syncPairedNumberInputs(baselineDpEpsInput, headerBaselineDpEpsInput, dpEps);\n    }\n    if (algos.includes(\"squish\")) {\n      const pct pct <= 0 || pct > 100) {\n        setBaselineStatus(\"SQUISH keep percent must be greater than 0 and at most 100.\", \"error\");\n        return;\n      }\n      squishRatio = squishRawFromDisplay(pct);\n      state.baselineSquishRatio = squishRatio;\n      syncPairedNumberInputs(\n        baselineSquishRatioInput,\n        headerBaselineSquishRatioInput,\n        squishDisplayFromRaw(squishRatio)\n      );\n    }\n\n    setCompareRunBusy(true);\n\n    const errors = [];\n    const skipped = [];\n    const ran = [];\n    const needFrechet = [];\n    let anyReady = false;\n    try {\n      for (const algo of algos) {\n        const params = baselineParamsFor(algo, { lssd, dpEps, squishRatio });\n        if (restoreCachedBaseline(algo, params)) {\n          skipped.push(baselineAlgoLabel(algo));\n          anyReady = true;\n          const fr = state.compare.frechet?.byAlgo?.[algo];\n          if (fr == null || (fr.value == null && !fr.loading)) needFrechet.push(algo);\n          renderCompareMetrics();\n          renderBaselineLayerToggles();\n          continue;\n        }\n        setBaselineStatus(`Running ${baselineAlgoLabel(algo)}…`);\n        const qs = new URLSearchParams({ algorithm: algo, run: \"1\" });\n        if (algo === \"dots\") qs.set(\"lssd\", String(lssd));\n        if (algo === \"dp\") qs.set(\"epsilon\", String(dpEps));\n        if (algo === \"squish\") qs.set(\"ratio\", String(squishRatio));\n        const resp = await fetch(`/api/trace/${currentTraceId}/compare?${qs.toString()}`);\n        if (!resp.ok) throw new Error(await apiErrorMessage(resp));\n        const data = await resp.json();\n        if (data.baseline_error || data.dots_error) {\n          errors.push(\n            `${baselineAlgoLabel(algo)}: ${plainUserError(data.baseline_error || data.dots_error)}`\n          );\n        } else {\n          ran.push(algo);\n        }\n        if (applyComparePayload(data)) const extra = skipped.length && !ran.length\n          ? \" Parameters unchanged; reused previous run.\"\n          : (skipped.length ? ` Reused ${skipped.join(\", \")} (unchanged).` : \"\");\n        for (const algo of [...ran, ...needFrechet]) startBaselineFrechet(algo);\n        render();\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      console.warn(\"[Compare] Compare run failed:\", err);\n      setBaselineStatus(plainUserError(err.message) || \"Compare run failed\", \"error\");\n    } finally {\n      setCompareRunBusy(false);\n    }\n  }\n\n  function startBaselineFrechet(algo) {\n    if (!currentTraceId || !algo || !state.compare?.layers?.[algo]) return;\n    state.compare.frechet = state.compare.frechet || { byAlgo: {} };\n    state.compare.frechet.byAlgo = state.compare.frechet.byAlgo || {};\n    state.compare.frechet.byAlgo[algo] = { loading: true, value: null };\n    renderCompareMetrics();\n })\n      .then((j) => {\n        if (!state.compare) return;\n        state.compare.frechet.byAlgo[algo] = { loading: false, value: j.distance };\n        const hit = Try a newer browser.\");\n    }\n\n    const reader = resp.body.getReader();\n    const decoder = new TextDecoder();\n    let buffer = \"\";\n    let sawDone = false;\n    let sawHeader = false;\n\n    while (true) {\n      const { done, value } = await reader.read();\n      if (done) break;\n      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });\n\n      let newlineIdx;\n      while ((newlineIdx = buffer.indexOf(\"\\n\")) >= 0) {\n        const line = buffer.slice(0, newlineIdx).trim();\n        buffer = buffer.slice(newlineIdx + 1);\n        if (!line) continue;\n\n        let msg;\n        try {\n          msg = JSON.parse(line);\n        } catch (e) {\n          throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n        }\n\n        // Batch JSON accidentally delivered as one NDJSON line.\n        if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = msg;\n          initTraceUI();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n          throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n        }\n        if (msg.type === \"header\") {\n          applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n          state.trace = {\n            eps: msg.eps,\n            delta: msg.delta,\n            grid_val: msg.grid_val,\n            r_val: msg.r_val,\n            expected_frechet: msg.expected_frechet,\n            bbox: msg.bbox,\n            stream: msg.stream,\n            prefixes: [],\n            simplified: null,\n            time_ms: null,\n          };\n          sawHeader = true;\n          state.prefixIdx = 0;\n          state.stepIdx = 0;\n          initTraceUI();\n          fitToData();\n          renderBootstrapStatus(state.trace);\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(total ? `Loading points 0 / ${total}…` : \"Loading points…\");\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"prefix\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          const prefix = msg.data;\n          applySampleTraceYOffsetToPrefix(prefix);\n          state.trace.prefixes.push(prefix);\n          if (state.prefixIdx === 0 && prefix.steps.length > 0) {\n            state.stepIdx = 0;\n          }\n          {\n            const total = state.trace.stream?.length ?? 0;\n            const loaded = Math.min((prefix.end_idx ?? 0) + 1, total || Infinity);\n            setTopBarTraceStatus(\n              total\n                ? `Loading points ${loaded} / ${total}…`\n                : `Loading points ${loaded}…`\n            );\n          }\n          render();\n        } else if (msg.type === \"done\") {\n          if (!state.trace) {\n            throw new Error(\"Trajectory data arrived out of order. Try loading again.\");\n          }\n          state.trace.time_ms = msg.time_ms;\n          state.trace.simplified = msg.simplified;\n          if (isSampleTraceId() && state.trace.simplified) {\n            state.trace.simplified.forEach((p) => { p[1] += 500; });\n          }\n          state.trace.frechet_distance = msg.frechet_distance ?? null;\n          sawDone = true;\n          renderParamsBar();\n          finalizeTraceLoad();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    const trailing = buffer.trim();\n    if (trailing) {\n      let msg;\n      try {\n        msg = JSON.parse(trailing);\n      } catch (e) {\n        throw new Error(\"Could not read trajectory data from the server. Try again in a moment.\");\n      }\n      if (!msg.type && Array.isArray(msg.prefixes)) {\n        applySampleTraceYOffset(msg);\n        state.trace = msg;\n        initTraceUI();\n        finalizeTraceLoad();\n        return;\n      }\n      if (msg.type === \"error\") {\n        throw new Error(plainUserError(msg.message || \"Could not load trajectory\"));\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!sawDone) {\n      if (!sawHeader) {\n        throw new Error(\"No data received from the server. point-in-polygon (world coords). Returns true if pt is inside poly.\n  function pointInPolygon(pt, poly) {\n    if (!poly || poly.length < 3) return false;\n    const [x, y] = pt;\n    let inside = false;\n    for (let i = 0, j = poly.length - 1; i < poly.length; j = i++) {\n      const [xi, yi] = poly[i], [xj, yj] = poly[j];\n      if (((yi > y) !== (yj > y)) && (x < (xj - xi) * (y - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi))\n        inside = !inside;\n    }\n    return inside;\n  }\n\n  function dot(p, radius, fillStyle, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.arc(x, y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);\n    if (fillStyle) { ctx.fillStyle = fillStyle; ctx.fill(); }\n    if (strokeStyle) { ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle; ctx.lineWidth = 1.5; ctx.stroke(); }\n  }\n\n  function cross(p, radius, strokeStyle) {\n    const [x, y] = worldToScreen(p[0], p[1]);\n    ctx.strokeStyle = strokeStyle;\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;\n    ctx.beginPath();\n    ctx.moveTo(x - xmin;\n    const yRange = ymax - ymin;\n\n    // Determine tick spacing based on data size\n    const getTickSpacing = (range) => {\n      const roughTicks = 8;\n      const roughSpacing = range / roughTicks;\n      const magnitude = Math.pow(10, Math.floor(Math.log10(roughSpacing)));\n      const normalized = roughSpacing / magnitude;\n      let nice;\n      if (normalized < 1.5) nice = 1;\n      else if (normalized < 3) nice = 2;\n      else if (normalized < 7) nice = 5;\n      else nice = 10;\n      return nice * magnitude;\n    };\n\n    const xSpacing = getTickSpacing(xRange);\n    const ySpacing = getTickSpacing(yRange);\n\n    // Position axes at the data bounds instead of world origin (0,0)\n    const xAxisY = ymin;\n    const yAxisX = xmin;\n\n    ctx.strokeStyle = \"#444\";\n    ctx.fillStyle = \"#999\";\n    ctx.lineWidth = 1;\n    ctx.font = \"11px monospace\";\n    ctx.textAlign = \"center\";\n    ctx.textBaseline = \"top\";\n\n    // X-axis ticks\n    const xStart = Math.ceil(xmin / xSpacing) * xSpacing;\n    for (let x = xStart; x <= xmax; x += xSpacing) {\n      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(x, xAxisY);\n      ctx.beginPath();\n      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy - bx1, by1 - by2);\n  }\n\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n  //  Main render\n  // -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n  function render() {\n    resizeCanvas();\n    const rect = canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect();\n    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, rect.width, rect.height);\n    renderStatus();\n\n    const t = state.trace;\n    const traceLoading = document.body.classList.contains(\"trace-loading\");\n    if (!t) {\n      if (isMobileUI()) {\n        for (const btn of mobileTransportButtons) {\n          if (btn) btn.disabled = true;\n        }\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const traceNotReady = traceLoading && (!t.prefixes || t.prefixes.length === 0);\n\n    const pfx = currentPrefix();\n    const step = currentStep();\n\n    // Draw axis ticks\n    drawAxisTicks();\n\n    // Update navigation input fields\n    segmentInput.value = `${state.prefixIdx + 1} / ${t.prefixes.length}`;\n    const n = pfx ? pfx.steps.length : 0;\n    stepInput.value = n ? `${state.stepIdx + 1} / ${n}` : \"0 / 0\";\n    \n    // Candidate display matches Status: position in the cycle pool (still-open + just-rejected)\n    const cand = candidateCycleInfo(step);\n    candidateInput.value = cand.total\n      ? `${cand.displayIdx} / ${cand.total}`\n      : \"0 / 0\";\n    if (mobileStepBackBtn) {\n      mobileStepBackBtn.disabled = traceNotReady || (state.prefixIdx === 0 && state.stepIdx === 0);\n    }\n    if (mobileStepForwardBtn) {\n      const atLastPrefix = state.prefixIdx === t.prefixes.length -
